title: IsMelee (spell flag)
html:
IsMelee is a unused[verify] spell flag. It does not determine the range of an action or whether an action is classified as a melee attack.

Compared to IsSpell (which actually determines which actions are proper spells), this flag has minimal gameplay impact.
